Foreign Affairs Section,
Special Branch. Station File No. Date June 19, 1942.

SUBJECT: The Hellenic Benevolent Society of China

The Hellenic Benevolent Society of China
(Shanghai) was founded some 20 years ago with the object
of giving moral and material assistance to Greek subjects
who may find themselves in need of such support.

The offices of the society are located at
the office of the President of the Society Mr. A.C.
Nicolachis, c/o Fagan & Co., 261 Kiangse Road, residing
at 468 Av. Joffre, flat C.301, whilst for the convenience
of Greeks residing in outports P.O. Box No.1279 is being
maintained.

The society is administered by a committee
comprising the following members:-
Mr. A.C. Nicolachis, President.
Mr. A. Vassiliou, Hon. Secretary.
Mr. N. Tsicrictsi, Hon. Treasurer.
Mr. N. Karas, member of the Committee.
Mr. F. Passikides, member of the Committee.
The society is composed of active members,
members and honourary members. Active members are
those Greek subjects who pay the admittance fee of $10.00
and contribute $2.00 monthly payable every three months
in advance.

Members are those Greek subjects or others
who make an annual contribution to the society of $10.00
payable in advance, and honourary members are those who
by reason of their services to the society are so elected
at the recommendation of the President or two members of
the Committee.

主题：中华希腊慈善会

中华希腊慈善会
（上海）成立于约20年前，其宗旨是为那些可能需要此类支持的希腊籍人士提供精神和物质援助。

该会的办事处设在会长 A.C. Nicolachis 先生的办公室，地址为江西路261号 Fagan & Co. 转交，其寓所为霞飞路468号 C.301 室；同时，为方便居住在外埠的希腊人，设有邮政信箱第1279号。

该会由以下成员组成的委员会管理：
A.C. Nicolachis 先生，会长。
A. Vassiliou 先生，名誉秘书。
N. Tsicrictsi 先生，名誉司库。
N. Karas 先生，委员会委员。
F. Passikides 先生，委员会委员。
该会由活跃会员、普通会员和荣誉会员组成。活跃会员是指缴纳10.00美元入会费并每月捐款2.00美元（每三个月预付一次）的希腊籍人士。

普通会员是指每年向该会预付10.00美元捐款的希腊籍人士或其他人士，荣誉会员是指因对该会有贡献，经会长或两名委员会委员推荐而当选的人士。

Apart from voluntary contributions which in

主题：

约250人，其中78人目前为该会会员。

除了委员会在必要时向其会员募集的自愿捐款外，该会还接受来自“联合外国慈善机构”（Associated Foreign Charities）和“法租界公益基金会”（Caisse des Oeuvres d'Interet Public de la Concession Francaise）的金钱捐赠，这些组织由慈善彩票（Loterie de Bienfaisance）总经理 A.S. Jaspar 先生管理。

1941年度的账目报表显示，上述两个组织向希腊慈善会捐赠了约2,000.00美元，个人捐款总额为326.00美元，会费收入为1,300.00美元。

按照惯例，该会活跃会员的全体大会每年一月举行，届时听取报告、通过账目并选举下一年度的委员会。然而，只要委员会认为必要，也可随时召开全体大会。

随函附上《中华希腊慈善会章程及附则》、《账目报表》及《会员名单》。

（印：...）
T.

A. Yamaguchi
外事科主管官员，
特别班。

S. 3, Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date March 16, 1942.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BT. REGISTRY No. IV. 1473 Date 17/3/42）

SUBJECT: Annual Meeting of Hellenic Benevolent Society

Sir,

I beg to report having this morning interviewed Mr. A.C. Nicolachis, President of the Hellenic Benevolent Society regarding the proposed meeting of the above said Society.

During the interview it was ascertained that the meeting will take place during the afternoon of March 29, 1942 at the premises of Foreign Y.M.C.A., 150 Bubbling Well Road.

The Society consists of about 60 members, but about 30 members expected to attended the meeting. The principal aim of the existence of the above said Society, is relief work amongst the poor class of Greek community in Shanghai.

The following matters will be discussed during the meeting.
1. Approval of Returns for last year (1941)
2. Increase of membership fees.
3. Election of New Committee.

N. Kochetov
D. S.
Officer i/c (Special Branch).
